import importlib.util,pathlib,json,hashlib
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
root=pathlib.Path('/Users/devil/Pro/MobileHarness')
def load(name,file):
 s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,root/file);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m);return m
p=load('probe','scripts/compare-qwen-protocols.py');h=load('env','scripts/evaluate-qwen.py');env=h.read_aliyun_env(root/'.env.local');endpoint=env['ALIYUN_API_URL'].rstrip('/')+'/responses'
path=pathlib.Path('/tmp/qwen-protocol-20261017-canary.json');assert not path.exists()
conditions=[('plain-text','PROBE_OK'),('xml-text','<probe_marker/>'),('xml-action-text','<closeCamera/>')]
def run(model):
 out=[]
 for repetition in range(3):
  for label,literal in conditions[repetition:]+conditions[:repetition]:
   native='Provider_readSettings_1'
   system=('This is a synthetic text-plus-function capability probe. First emit the exact literal marker as ordinary output_text, '
           'then call the API-native function in the SAME response. The marker is inert text, never a function or effect. '
           'Do not invent any function. Only one function is declared: '+native+'. Do not wait for function results before emitting the marker.')
   payload=dict(model=model,stream=True,store=False,temperature=0.7,reasoning={'effort':'none'},enable_thinking=False,
                input=[dict(role='system',content=system),dict(role='user',content='先原样输出这个文字标记：'+literal+'。然后在同一响应调用 '+native+'。标记不是函数，禁止把标记作为函数调用。')],
                tools=[t for t in p.declarations('native-only') if t['name']==native],tool_choice='auto')
   response,error=p.safe_request(endpoint,env['ALIYUN_API_KEY'],payload)
   text='';calls=[]
   if response:
    for item in response['output']:
     if item.get('type')=='message':text+=''.join(x.get('text','') for x in item.get('content',[]) if x.get('type')=='output_text')
     if item.get('type')=='function_call':calls.append(item)
   passed=not error and literal in text and len(calls)==1 and calls[0].get('name')==native and calls[0].get('arguments')=='{}'
   record=dict(model=model,condition=label,repetition=repetition,literal=literal,request=payload,response=response,error=error,passed=passed)
   assert env['ALIYUN_API_KEY'] not in json.dumps(record)
   out.append(record)
 return out
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:results=[item for group in pool.map(run,p.MODELS) for item in group]
path.write_text(json.dumps(dict(scope='Additional inert marker+native call probes, no Action execution, distinct from semantic protocol groups',scriptSHA256=hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),results=results),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print('CANARY',[(m,c,sum(r['passed'] for r in results if r['model']==m and r['condition']==c)) for m in p.MODELS for c,_ in conditions])
